what_happened: Research found .sapience/project.json cannot carry a project 'key' field (repo_link.py's parse_link rejects secret-shaped keys), so the repo-tagged-KO publisher must resolve the project key at runtime via GET /v1/people/projects matching the binding's cid, not from the binding file directly. Also found test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh's Case 30 lockstep array (7 files) is out of this task's file_scope, so adding sapience-publish.sh as an 8th copy of the worktree-checkout-resolution block leaves that global guard incomplete unless file_scope is widened or the gap is explicitly recorded at plan time.

Dependency task 647 already delivered scripts/lib/sapience-api-lib.sh and scripts/sapience-project-bind.sh with exactly the host/token resolution, dry-run redaction, loud-failure conventions, and worktree-checkout-resolution block this task needs -- no re-derivation needed, straightforward reuse/template for sapience-publish.sh and its test suite.

Plan-time re-derivation found the dispatch's FILE SCOPE (2 new files) is incomplete in a commit-blocking way: check-extension-docs.sh (gate 3) Rule at line 616 FAILs with 'script file on disk NOT in provides.scripts' for any tracked script under an extension's scripts/ that is absent from manifest.json provides.scripts. Creating sapience-publish.sh and tests/test-sapience-publish.sh without adding both to agent-system/extensions/sapience/manifest.json therefore red-lines gate 3 at the phase-closing commit. The dependency task 647's own file_scope already included manifest.json for exactly this reason. Plan widens file_scope by manifest.json plus tests/test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh (Case 30 lockstep array, 7 entries today, 8th copy of the worktree block).

The research report's per-endpoint re-derivation against brain_server.py removed essentially all design ambiguity from the plan: the base_rev-not-base_hash concurrency key, the three distinct doc-version exit paths (409 head_moved / 202 people_propose / 404 share_gone), the shared comment-POST helper between doc-comment and dm, and the runtime GET /v1/people/projects key resolution all transferred into phases without any further investigation at plan time.
